themes.description: Users report frequent app crashes, delays in FD processing, and difficulties with refunds, resulting in frustration and mistrust of the platform. The majority of users experience these issues while trying to withdraw their money.
themes.business_impact: High refund processing times, significant reputational damage, lost trust among customers, potential loss of revenue due to failed FDs.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Lack of robust backend infrastructure, inadequate testing, and insufficient quality assurance processes may contribute to app crashes and refund issues.
themes.action_plan: • Conduct thorough root cause analysis, enhance backend infrastructure, implement robust testing and QA processes, establish a clear refund policy and improve customer support.
